rachel-p: Hey team — Ben from KappaSilicon pinged me. They want a gated early access for their new A1 boards. NDA is in place but they want telemetry hooks and an initial benchmark plan before we grant remote access. Can we scope?

ben-hw: we have 6 units available in their lab starting next week, access windows are 9am-5pm PST M-F. boards are single-socket A1-80 with 128GB HBM. they want throughput and 95th pct latency for seq lengths 512/2048.

sam-ml: nice. need to confirm which models they expect onbox. ask if they want OPT-family, Bloom, or smaller LLMs. Also whether int8/qat quantization is allowed — affects perf numbers.

tariq-platform: for private access we should provision a temporary VPC peering + audit endpoint. we'll need ip allowlist and a short-lived service account. also recommend we run workloads from our dedicated staging pool (not prod).

eva-legal: NDA ok but watch the export control clause — Kappa flagged some firmware-level telemetry that might be restricted. we should redact or get explicit permission for any low-level chip telemetry (temperature, voltage traces).

rachel-p: good call. Ben — can you confirm the telemetry fields they expect us to ingest and whether they include low-level sensor traces? link to NDA so ops can check: <https://kappa.example.com/nda/abc123>

ben-hw: they listed: model/firmware version, timestamped perf counters, occupancy, and optional thermal samples. thermal samples are optional but useful. i'll ask if they can limit resolution.

sam-ml: for the bench plan i'd propose: 1) microbench (matmul, attention kernels) 2) end-to-end inference (gpt-like seq512/2048) 3) multi-request throughput with batching profiles. we should include warm/cold cache runs. example run command to standardize results:

```
run_bench --model gptj-6b --batch 1,4,8 --seq 512,2048 --quant none,int8 --trials 5 --report json
```

tariq-platform: infra notes: we'll need an s3 bucket in their region for artifacts, a dedicated service account with read-only, and an ssh bastion for debug. can we use ephemeral credentials? if so, we'll script teardown after validation.

ci-bot: Automated: created folder /partnerships/kappa/A1-eap-2034567890 and uploaded initial bench template: <https://ci.internal/downloads/kappa/A1/template.yaml> (uploader: rachel-p).

rachel-p: thanks bot. next steps: (1) Ben to confirm telemetry resolution and signed addendum if needed (2) Sam to draft bench plan and target metrics (3) Tariq to outline VPC/credentials playbook (4) Eva to confirm export/nda scope. Assignments?

ben-hw: i'll get telemetry clarification by EOD tomorrow.

sam-ml: i'll put a bench draft up mid-day Thursday, will include reproducible scripts and golden traces.

tariq-platform: i'll draft the access runbook and ephemeral creds flow — targeting Friday morning.

eva-legal: will review export controls and flag anything needing vendor sign-off by Friday EOD.

rachel-p: perfect. i'm scheduling a short sync with Kappa for Thu 9am PT — i'll invite the group. please drop any pre-read into the ci folder. Also +1 on canarying on our dedicated pool before granting lab access. :thumbsup:

ben-hw: ack. i'll also ask if they can provide a small firmware image we can run in a sandbox to validate telemetry format.

sam-ml: small ask — can we enable otel traces from the runtime? helps correlate latency spikes with hardware counters. if Kappa is okay with trace ids, we'll include that in the telemetry addendum.

eva-legal: otel traces are fine provided they don't include PII or raw customer prompt text. addendum should explicitly prohibit content ingestion.

rachel-p: noted. i'll put that language in the pre-read. thanks all — I'll post the calendar invite and link to the pre-read in this thread.

ci-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled Thu 09:00 PT — join link: <https://meet.internal/meet/2034567890>

ben-hw: saw it, thanks. we'll aim to have a short firmware spec and telemetry CSV schema in the pre-read.

rachel-p: closing loop — if anything blocks, ping me or drop in #partnerships.

(reacts: :rocket:)
